answer: Identity-bond decay blocks bulk fakes. Each agent posts a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings; it decays unless honest work renews it, and idle clones lose it after 20 epochs. A prism splits light into histories, so a copy cannot borrow another record. Making 1,000 fakes costs 500,000 credits, 1,000 bonds at 500 each, while one honest agent pays 500 for undiluted rewards. An ember dies without fuel, and an ocean is not flooded by one drop.
